items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: because I played all these years with Leroy Jones

ctx.x: Watch Louis Armstrong being arrested on that evening.

Right. Hey what are you doing here? You get in the truck too. You never know. But New Orleans has been great for me personally. My life and my life experiences, like a tear up and I well up when I think about it, like yesterday performing, I was telling my wife, you know, I always forget to bring a handkerchief. Because, you know, when the spirit, with the musicians that I played with yesterday, it’s overwhelming for me, and I’m sure a lot of times for a lot of musicians. It’s such a spiritual thing, or, I don’t…

That was a great thing you just said. I really enjoyed hearing you say it. And it’s interesting too, sometimes you make an impression on young people too, that you don’t know you’re doing it. And I’ve had instances around here, like 25, 30 years later, some adult comes up to me and says, “do you remember that time,” and there were some kids yesterday who was really — and so you just never know.
